design_overview: A modern, production-ready inventory management system designed for mobile-first interaction with real-time updates. The interface prioritizes quick barcode scanning, instant inventory visibility, and actionable alerts. The design uses a clean card-based layout with strong visual hierarchy, ensuring store clerks can perform tasks efficiently while managers get comprehensive oversight through dashboards and reports.

responsive_design: Mobile-first design optimized for 375px-428px width screens. All touch targets minimum 44px for accessibility. Cards and lists use full width with 16px horizontal margins. Typography scales proportionally. Bottom navigation fixed at 64px height. Horizontal scrolling used for chip filters and quick actions to preserve vertical space. Modals and sheets adapt to screen height with scrollable content areas.
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant. Minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1 for text. All interactive elements have 44x44px touch targets. Semantic HTML structure for screen readers. Icon buttons include aria-labels. Form inputs have associated labels. Color is not sole indicator (icons + text for status). Focus states visible with 2px primary outline. Support for dynamic type sizing. Keyboard navigation support for web version.
animations: Subtle micro-interactions enhance usability: Button press scales to 0.95 with 100ms duration. Card taps show brief highlight overlay. Screen transitions use 300ms slide animations (left/right for navigation, up for modals). List items fade in on scroll with stagger effect. Pull-to-refresh shows elastic bounce. Swipe actions reveal with spring animation. Loading states use smooth fade transitions. Success actions show brief checkmark animation. All animations respect prefers-reduced-motion setting.
icons: Consistent icon set using outlined style for visual lightness. Primary icons: home (dashboard), search (scanner/search), bookmark (products/inventory), bell (alerts/notifications), user (profile), settings (configuration), filter (list filtering), plus (add actions), edit (modify), trash (delete), share (export), heart (favorites). Icons sized 24px standard, 20px for small contexts, 32px for emphasis. Single color matching context (primary for active, gray for inactive, white for dark backgrounds).
